## Research

I am working on three research projects this summer:


**Research Assistant** \| University of Chicago, via PREDOC \| Summer 2026

- **Self-Command and Screen-Time: Evidence from an Educational Intervention** (with Mridul Joshi, Jalnidh Kaur and Lena Song) — *Conditionally accepted at the Journal of Development Economics based on pre-results review.* A randomized controlled trial evaluating a digital empowerment intervention for college students in Punjab, India. 

- **Mobile Phones and Gender Attitudes in Sub-Saharan Africa** — Observational study of how mobile phone expansion affects gender-related attitudes and behaviors, exploiting exogenous variation in phone coverage from lightning strikes. *(more details soon.)*

**Research Assistant** \| Macalester College, via MSCS Department \| Summer 2026

- **Health Impacts of the Hennepin Energy Recovery Center (HERC)** — Evaluating the true causal impact of HERC, a trash incinerator in the Twin Cities, on health outcomes in surrounding communities. *(more details soon.)*

## Papers

[**Inequalities in the U.S. Labor Market**](/posts/metrics/) — Econometrics research quantifying wage disparities by gender and citizenship status using a Mincer earnings regression and Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition on 500K+ ACS records (2012–2019). Published in the *Macalester Street Journal: Equilibrium*, Vol. 3 (2025). See the [full project page](/posts/metrics/) for more information.

- I will be presenting this paper at the **PREDOC Research Conference** at the Booth School of Business, University of Chicago, in **July 2026**.

## Industry Experience

**Data Science Intern** \| Metropolitan Council, St. Paul, MN \| Jan 2026–May 2026

- Analyze Travel Behavior Inventory data from 5,000+ households with the Transportation Research team, developing R scripts to model travel disparities for the *Imagine 2050* Transportation Policy Plan.

**Technical Lead** \| Data Science Final Project, Macalester College \| Jan 2026–May 2026

- Led API extraction, data pipeline, and code architecture for a team analyzing [AI adoption, wage premiums, and payroll growth across U.S. industries](https://mac-stat212-s26.github.io/project-economics-and-ds/) using Census Bureau ABS data and a Random Forest model.

**Extern** \| Analysis Group, Boston, MA \| Aug 2025

- Researched TV network–cable provider disputes in a mock damages case, analyzing channel blackout trends and writing a summary memo.

## Leadership Experiences

I have participated in research and training programs such as the [Expanding Diversity in Economics](https://www.macalester.edu/news/2024/04/three-macalester-students-selected-for-university-of-chicagos-prestigious-economics-program/) (EDE) Program at the University of Chicago (Summer 2024), the [Mathematical Modeling and Public Health Workshop](https://hsph.harvard.edu/epidemiology/news/mathematical-modeling-and-public-health-workshop/) at Harvard Chan School (March 2025), and [SUMMIT@BOOTH](https://www.chicagobooth.edu/phd/admissions/events/summit-booth/summit-2025-cohort) hosted by Chicago Booth at the University of Chicago (November 2025).

Prior to college, I completed the International Baccalaureate (IB) at [UWC Red Cross Nordic](https://www.uwc.org/rcn) in Flekke, Norway, where I lived and studied alongside students from around the world. During my time there, I represented both the UWC movement and my school at [the Nobel Peace Prize Ceremony](https://uwcrcn.no/nobel-peace-prize_2022/) in Oslo in December 2022. Beyond academics, I spent my time hiking, diving, and growing—personally and intellectually.
